summary.conclusion: Complete Oct 12–14 JST MyJVN modification window: 137 distinct all-product rows. The 16 selected library rows comprise 7 existing Reviewed aliases, 8 independently verified package proposals and 1 unresolved vLLM candidate. The 19 prior candidates and 241 historical rows are retained. Three official feeds include 2 new unique notices (AssetView and Thelia), both outside the seven-ecosystem library scope. Eight Elastic server-product notices receive no inferred client-library mapping. KEV remains unknown/unverified after one HTTP 403.
